steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Cinematography encompasses all visual choices made with the camera to create meaning and emotion in film. | Key Fact: Camera shots are defined by distance: extreme long shot establishes setting, long shot shows full body, medium shot frames waist-up, close-up fills the frame with face or object, extreme close-up isolates a tiny detail. | Key Fact: Camera angles communicate power and status: low angles make subjects appear powerful and dominant, high angles make them seem vulnerable or small, eye-level angles feel neutral and objective. | Key Fact: Dutch or canted angles create unease, disorientation and psychological instability, commonly used in horror and thriller genres.
